known_distinctions: Eq23 includes a first-gradient defect subtraction to reduce disorder error. It is not automatically a generally quadratic-exact Hessian or a guaranteed higher convergence order.

For2D Dmn=4*rm*rn/r2-delta_mn. Its isotropic trace is2. In the same receiver-C/volume/neighborhood/zero-Eta2/no-boundary-substitution limit, the scalar trace can coincide with the current Taylor-defect form; algebraic equality is a valid test result, not evidence the task can be skipped.
Current production additionally uses pair-averaged C, stored Eta2 and a closed-face gradient target. Separate these differences instead of changing all of them in a coupled physical A/B.
Any3D tensor extension needs its own dimensional derivation; do not transplant coefficient4 or replace scalar trace2 with3.
Eq25 pair-mean variable permeability is a later separate comparison with the current receiver-k/product-rule law, not proof from constant-k tests.
bounded_order: Check originalPDF/index/sign/dimensional conventions; write one literal reference and an algebraic same-limit crosscheck.

Compare constant/affine/quadratic and smooth modes on matched regular, controlled-disorder and truncated-neighborhood clouds in2D and justified3D; retain all six Hessian components when testing3D, not only a scalar trace.

Quantify derivative errors, constant null response, linear defect, conditioning, pair/global residuals, measured work and memory. Quadratic errors are diagnostics, not an assumed exactness claim; check dissipative/discrete spectral behavior before integration.

Only a justified candidate proceeds to existing1D and Cryer same-physics native/half/backend compatibility and actual-time theory comparisons. Keep original safety and5Pa/.005mm limits; operator option changes are not half-step errors.

Merge only if real accuracy/robustness improves at acceptable measured cost, or record demonstrated equivalence/no worthwhile benefit and retain the existing operator. Synchronize docs and verify selective local/remote Git.
